label: to review
Proposed: Mainz
research:
The archival abstract names Dr. Hermann Rosenberg, scholaster of St. Maria ad gradus, among collectors acknowledging a 50-gulden subsidy. His office and contemporaneous colleagues connect him with the same scholaster in 1444-07-06.json and 1457-04-30.json. Bauer (bauer_1872.json) could not place the 1452 scholaster and vicar general in the Franken genealogy and considered non-noble origin possible. The Mainz patrician family is another possibility, but no kinship links him to it. His Mainz office and surname alone do not distinguish either family. The 1449 archiepiscopal register corroborates his office and colleagues: https://www.ingrossaturbuecher.de/index.php?cHash=346098438fe451949fb23ed021a533c4&id=380&tx_hisodat_sources%5Baction%5D=show&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bcontroller%5D=Sources&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bsource%5D=22092. Attribution unresolved. Compare 1457_2.json: both are 50-gulden receipts, but their named collectors, notaries, and stated sealers differ; they appear to be separate receipts rather than identical copies, subject to checking the originals. Both abstracts confusingly name Konrad in the heading and Theodor in the body; this discrepancy does not establish a redating.

Further research supports Mainz. The receipt’s name form Hermannus Rosemberg, doctorate in canon law and office as scholaster of Mariengreden identify the cleric whom F. W. E. Roth places in the Mainz patrician Rosenberg family (Archiv für katholisches Kirchenrecht 80, 1900, pp. 189–192, https://archive.org/details/ArchivFuerKatholischesKirchenrecht1900/page/n191/mode/1up). The Easter 1425 Erfurt matriculation groups Hermanus and Iacobus Rosenberg as de Maguncia (Weissenborn I, p. 131, https://archive.org/details/11698564bsb/page/n162/mode/1up). The Repertorium Academicum Germanicum lists Hermann as a Mainz patrician (https://resource.database.rag-online.org/ngLB2O476LT2xahbfLkaw). His exact kinship to Jakob remains open.

entries.german:
Quittung über 50 Gulden als subsidium extraordinarium an Erzbischof Konrad von Mainz.

Conradus Ruwe, Senior, Henricus de Morle, decr. lic., Hermannus Rosemberg, decr. Dr., Scholasticus b. Marie ad gradus intra muros, und Sanderus de Martißhusen, Kanoniker von St. Peter extra muros, Commissare und Collectoren der beiden größeren Subsidien und der sechs Procurationen für Erzbischof Theodor von Mainz, quittieren, daß sie von Dekan und Kapitel des Liebfrauenstifts auf dem Berg 50 Gulden erhalten haben.

Siegler: S.: Heinrich (Rest).Unterschrift von Conradus Geißmarus, notarius.

Siegler: S.: Heinrich (Rest).
Unterschrift von Conradus Geißmarus, notarius.
entries.english:
Receipt for 50 guilders as subsidium extraordinarium to Archbishop Konrad of Mainz.

Conradus Ruwe, Senior, Henricus de Morle, decr. lic., Hermannus Rosemberg, decr. Dr., Scholasticus b. Marie ad gradus intra muros, and Sanderus de Martißhusen, Canon of St. Peter extra muros, Commissioners and Collectors of the two larger subsidies and the six procurations for Archbishop Theodor of Mainz, acknowledge that they have received 50 guilders from the Dean and Chapter of the Liebfrauenstift auf dem Berg.

Seal: S.: Heinrich (remainder).Signature by Conradus Geißmarus, notary.

Seal: S.: Heinrich (remainder).
Signature by Conradus Geißmarus, notary.
